title_block.title: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 8
title_block.sheet_note: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 8 - View A. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 66, 90; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 8 - View B. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 68, 76, 94; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 8 - View C. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 54; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 8 - View D. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 76, 77, 99
title_block.standard: ASME Y14.5M-1994 (dimensioning and tolerancing); ASME Y14.41-2003 (dataset)

features.label: whole part
features.description: The part as a whole. General notes apply to all of it.

features.label: two corner holes in the flange (2X)
features.description: Two of the four small holes in the corners of the outer flange: the back one and the right one in view A.

features.label: top face of the flange
features.description: The wide flat top face of the outer flange around the raised deck (view A). It is datum feature A.

features.label: top face of the raised deck
features.description: The flat top face of the raised deck in the middle of the part, beside the long slot (view B).

features.label: hatched band on the front wall
features.description: The hatched band on the long front wall of the raised deck, between the lines marked L1 and L2 (view B).

features.label: square cutout in the deck
features.description: Square through cutout in the raised deck near the front corner, where the coordinate triad sits (view C).

features.label: keyhole slot on the left
features.description: Keyhole-shaped through slot (a round hole joined to a smaller lobe) in the left part of the raised deck (view D).

values.meaning: Each of the two corner holes must be between .237 and .243 in in diameter (.238 in, up to .005 over or .001 under).

Position at maximum material condition, checked in the free state: the axis of each corner hole must lie in a .023 in diameter cylinder at its true position from datums A, B and C, with the part unrestrained (Ⓕ) rather than held as note 5 describes.
Datum feature A: the flange top face is the primary reference. The symbol hangs from the two flatness frames that control this face.
General note 6: all dimensions on the drawing are in inches.

values.applies_to: tangent plane of the face (top row of a two-frame stack)
values.meaning: Parallelism of the tangent plane: the plane that rests on the high points of the deck top face must lie between two planes .015 in apart that are parallel to datum D.

values.applies_to: only the hatched band between lines L1 and L2
values.meaning: Flatness between L1 and L2: the hatched band of the front wall must lie between two parallel planes .015 in apart; no datum is used.

values.applies_to: all side walls of the cutout (all-around circle on the leader)
values.meaning: Profile of a surface, all around: every side wall of the square cutout must lie in a .015 in band around its true shape, located from datum D and from datum feature G at its maximum material boundary.

values.applies_to: side length of the square cutout
values.meaning: Reference dimension: the square cutout is about 1.100 in on a side; given for information only, not for inspection.

values.applies_to: the whole outline of the slot (all-around circle on the leader)
values.meaning: Profile of a surface, all around: the keyhole slot's walls must lie in a .015 in band around their true shape, located from datum D and the common datum H-J, both features at maximum material boundary.
